admin.bulkDescription: Every time slot on every day, for one team. Times are local times in {zone}; a slot that ends before it starts ends the next day.
admin.cancelAssignmentDescription: Their place is freed and an open swap of it is cancelled.
admin.copyDescription: Copies the shift roles and shifts, not who works them. Teams of another operation are matched by name.
admin.deleteRoleDescription: A role that shifts or assignments use cannot be deleted.
admin.deleteRoleFailed: Could not delete the shift role
admin.deleteScheduleDescription: Its shift roles and shifts are deleted too. A schedule with people on its shifts cannot be deleted.
admin.deleteShiftDescription: A shift with people on it cannot be deleted: take them off first.
admin.draftNote: Draft: volunteers do not see this schedule until you publish it.
admin.endsAfterStart: A shift must end after it starts.
admin.maxPerShiftHelp: Used when a shift sets no capacity. Empty is no limit.
admin.maxShiftsPerDayHelp: More shows a warning; volunteers cannot swap past it.
admin.minPerShiftHelp: Fewer shows the shift as short.
admin.minRestHoursHelp: Less shows a warning; volunteers cannot swap past it.
admin.name: Name
admin.noCandidates: Nobody on the team matches. People need an approved place or a role added in Teams.
admin.noRolesDescription: Without roles anybody on the team can hold any shift.
admin.noSchedulesDescription: Create a schedule, then add shifts for the teams.
admin.noShiftsDescription: Create shifts for a team over a range of days, or copy them from another schedule.
admin.offsetDaysHelp: The shifts keep their local times. 364 keeps the weekday a year on.
admin.publishDescription: Volunteers see their shifts in it and can swap them. A published schedule cannot go back to draft.
admin.rangeInvalid: The last day must be on or after the first.
admin.roleDescription: A role people hold on a shift, such as BA or bartender, with the lowest team role that may hold it.
admin.rolesDescription: Roles such as BA or bartender, with the lowest team role that may hold them.
admin.scheduleDescription: A schedule holds the shifts of an operation. It stays a draft until you publish it.
admin.schedulesDescription: Each schedule holds shifts for the operation's teams. Publish it when it is ready.
admin.shortStaffed: Short of people: {count} of at least {min}

swapModes.approvalHelp: A lead of the team or staff approves each swap.
swapModes.peerHelp: A swap is done as soon as the owner accepts an offer.

admin.swapsApprovalHelp: Swaps the owner accepted wait here for a lead of the team or staff.
admin.swapsPeerHelp: This schedule swaps between volunteers: nothing waits for approval.
admin.teamRoleHelp: People below it on the team's ladder cannot hold this role.
